questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All cameras are rugs.All rugs are bananas.All bananas are lamps.Conclusions: (I) All cameras are lamps.(II) Some lamps are rugs.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.) है।

B sits third to the right of A. D sits to the immediate left of the person facing P. S faces the person sitting second to the left of C. R does not face D. Who amongst the following faces D?

In this question, two statement are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of them logically follow(s) beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statements.Statements:A. Consuming fast foods on a regular basis and lack of physical exercise can cause diabetes.B. One must consume a balanced diet of complex carbs, protein, essential fats, vitamins and minerals as well as probiotics for a good health.Conclusions:I. Controlling the portions of food we consume can help us fight diabetes.II. Consuming a balanced diet and regular exercise can help keep diabetes at bay.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only conclusion II follows.) है।
